description: Fivebar's index of x402 payments (USDG transferWithAuthorization) on Robinhood Chain: the last 24 hours and recent days, screened before they count. Volume that doesn't pass is split two ways: flaggedUsd shows a wash pattern (a seller paying itself, circular payments, two wallets paying 90%+ of a seller); tooFewBuyersUsd only went to sellers with under 10 distinct buyers, which isn't evidence of washing, just not enough to judge yet. topSellers lists sellers that passed. Updated every 3 hours.
name: x402_stats
title: x402 payments on Robinhood Chain
